worldcombat.skill.lockon.summary: Clamp your aim onto one foe and drag it along your line of fire so the next hit cannot slip; the lock is spent when it lands on the locked target.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.0: Pin a foe before it slips away
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.1: Set up a hit that must land
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.2: Drag a fast target down for the focus fire
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.0: The reticle holds the foe for %1$s, and the target is dragged down for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.1: two rings close in on the target.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.2: Lock range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s. Single target and needs line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.hold.on: Clamp: window x1.5 and the target's movement and flight are pinned, but windup costs %1$s more and cooldown grows to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.hold.off: Loose lock: only drags the target down, with a shorter window and cooldown, good for holding foes on your line often.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.hold: On, the target is fully pinned in the reticle: window x1.5 and movement and flight pinned to zero, but a longer windup and cooldown; off only drags it down, with a shorter window and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.ai.m: The companion only locks while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller locks at point-blank, larger approaches to lock.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.ai.l: When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from leaving its post to lock on.
